why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Jose Altuve is slot #4 (4.720 expected team runs/game).
Slots #4, #5, #3, #2, #1, #6 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.008 R/G.
Slot #4 yields 4.39 expected PA/game vs 4.71 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
